title: 7 No-Code Website Builders 2026: Bubble Webflow Framer Compared
description: Compare 7 no-code website builders in 2026: Bubble, Webflow, Framer, Softr, Wix Studio, FlutterFlow, Glide. Pricing and use cases with Gartner data.
content:
# Top 7 No-Code Website & App Builders 2026: Bubble vs Webflow vs Framer vs Softr

The no-code revolution is no longer a trend — it is the default. According to Gartner's 2026 report, **75% of applications will be developed using low-code or no-code platforms**, up from 41% in 2021. For solopreneurs, this means you can launch a fully functional SaaS product, e-commerce store, or content platform without writing a single line of code.

In this comprehensive guide, we compare **7 leading no-code builders** across pricing, use cases, flexibility, and limitations. Whether you need a marketing site, a full web app, or a mobile app, here is everything you need to choose the right platform in 2026.

## The No-Code Landscape in 2026

The market has matured significantly. The top 7 platforms have each carved out distinct niches:

- **Bubble:** Full-stack web applications with complex logic
- **Webflow:** Design-first marketing sites and CMS platforms
- **Framer:** Marketing sites with animation and design precision
- **Softr:** Portal and membership sites from Airtable/Google Sheets
- **Wix Studio:** Agency-grade sites with a massive template library
- **FlutterFlow:** Full native mobile apps from a visual builder
- **Glide:** Simple mobile apps and dashboards from spreadsheets

## 1. Bubble

**Founded:** 2012 | **Users:** 4M+ | **Typical Use:** Web apps, SaaS MVPs, marketplaces

Bubble remains the undisputed king of no-code web applications. Its visual programming model lets you build complex logic, databases, user authentication, and third-party API integrations entirely without code.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** 50 units of capacity, Bubble branding
- **Starter:** $29/month — 100 units, custom domain
- **Growth:** $119/month — 250 units, 50GB storage
- **Team:** $399/month — 750 units, 150GB, multiple environments
- **Enterprise:** Custom

### Strengths
- Unmatched flexibility for complex web apps
- Built-in database with workflows and scheduling
- Native API connector for external services
- Plugin ecosystem with 2,500+ plugins

### Weaknesses
- Learning curve is steep for non-technical users
- Performance can be slower than custom code
- Mobile performance is subpar (responsive, not native)

### Best For
Building a **full SaaS MVP** or **marketplace platform** without developers. Many successful startups (including several Y Combinator graduates) launched on Bubble.

## 2. Webflow

**Founded:** 2013 | **Users:** 5M+ | **Typical Use:** Marketing sites, CMS, portfolios

Webflow combines a visual design tool with a powerful CMS and hosting. It is the go-to for designers who want pixel-perfect control without writing HTML/CSS.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Starter:** Free — 2 projects, webflow.io subdomain
- **Basic:** $18/month — custom domain, 100 pages
- **CMS:** $29/month — 2,000 CMS items, 3 content editors
- **Business:** $49/month — 10,000 CMS items, 10 editors
- **Enterprise:** Custom

### Strengths
- Best-in-class visual design tool
- Clean, standards-compliant code output
- Powerful CMS for content-heavy sites
- Excellent SEO capabilities

### Weaknesses
- No server-side logic or user authentication
- E-commerce is limited compared to Shopify
- Can get expensive with higher-tier plans

### Best For
**Marketing sites, portfolios, and content-driven websites** where design quality matters most.

## 3. Framer

**Founded:** 2020 | **Users:** 2M+ | **Typical Use:** Marketing sites, landing pages, microsites

Framer evolved from a prototyping tool into a full website builder. It is known for its **stunning animation capabilities** and real-time collaboration features.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** 1 site, framer.website subdomain
- **Mini:** $5/month — custom domain, 100 pages
- **Basic:** $10/month — 1,000 pages, CMS
- **Pro:** $25/month — 10,000 pages, 10 editors, analytics
- **Enterprise:** Custom

### Strengths
- Best animation and micro-interaction capabilities
- Fastest time-to-launch for beautiful landing pages
- Real-time collaboration with design teams
- Clean, modern templates

### Weaknesses
- Limited for complex web applications
- CMS is less mature than Webflow
- Smaller plugin/third-party ecosystem

### Best For
**High-converting landing pages** and **startup marketing sites** where animation and design impact matter.

## 4. Softr

**Founded:** 2020 | **Users:** 500K+ | **Typical Use:** Portals, membership sites, client dashboards

Softr connects to Airtable or Google Sheets as its backend and lets you build membership portals, client dashboards, and internal tools in minutes.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** Up to 10 users, 2 published apps, Softr branding
- **Starter:** $29/month — 100 users, custom domain, remove branding
- **Pro:** $79/month — 1,000 users, team collaboration, custom code
- **Business:** $199/month — 10,000 users, SSO, audit logs

### Strengths
- Fastest time-to-launch for portal-style apps
- Airtable/Sheets as a database is intuitive for non-technical users
- Pre-built blocks for common app patterns
- User authentication and permissions built-in

### Weaknesses
- Limited to simple app patterns (CRUD-based)
- Backend is constrained by Airtable/Sheets limits
- Not suitable for complex business logic

### Best For
**Client portals, membership sites, and internal dashboards** that need to launch quickly.

## 5. Wix Studio

**Founded:** 2006 (Studio launched 2024) | **Users:** 10M+ | **Typical Use:** Business sites, e-commerce, agencies

Wix Studio is the agency-focused version of Wix, offering a professional-grade design tool with Wix's massive template library and app marketplace.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** Wix branding, subdomain
- **Combo:** $16/month — custom domain, no ads
- **Unlimited:** $22/month — unlimited bandwidth, 10GB storage
- **Business Basic:** $33/month — accept payments, 50GB
- **Business Unlimited:** $55/month — 100GB, subscriptions
- **Agency plans:** Custom

### Strengths
- Largest template library (800+)
- Built-in e-commerce and booking systems
- Velo by Wix for added custom code
- App marketplace with 500+ integrations

### Weaknesses
- Template lock-in can make migration hard
- Less design freedom than Webflow/Framer
- Performance can be bloated

### Best For
**Small business websites** and **agencies** that need a reliable, all-in-one platform.

## 6. FlutterFlow

**Founded:** 2020 | **Users:** 1M+ | **Typical Use:** Native mobile apps, cross-platform apps

FlutterFlow builds native Flutter applications from a visual drag-and-drop interface. It is unique in this list as the only platform producing **truly native mobile code**.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** 3 projects, web preview only
- **Standard:** $30/month — iOS/Android builds, custom domain
- **Pro:** $70/month — unlimited projects, API access, team features
- **Teams:** $180/month — version control, custom roles

### Strengths
- Generates real Flutter code you can export
- True native performance on iOS and Android
- Firebase and Supabase integration
- Custom widget and API support

### Weaknesses
- Steeper learning curve for non-technical users
- Desktop/web support is secondary
- Need some understanding of Flutter concepts

### Best For
**Native mobile apps** where you need real app store performance, not a web wrapper.

## 7. Glide

**Founded:** 2018 | **Users:** 2M+ | **Typical Use:** Simple mobile apps, dashboards, internal tools

Glide builds apps from spreadsheets (Google Sheets, Excel) with a focus on simplicity. It is the easiest way to turn a spreadsheet into a functional mobile app.

### Pricing (2026)
- **Free:** Up to 10 users, Glide branding
- **Starter:** $25/month — 100 users, custom domain, remove branding
- **Pro:** $99/month — 1,000 users, privacy controls, API access
- **Enterprise:** Custom

### Strengths
- Fastest way to turn a spreadsheet into an app
- Beautiful pre-built templates
- No learning curve for spreadsheet users
- Mobile-friendly by default

### Weaknesses
- Limited flexibility for complex apps
- Spreadsheet-based backend hits limits at scale
- Not suitable for public-facing consumer apps

### Best For
**Internal tools, data dashboards, and simple mobile apps** for small teams.

## Comparison Table

| Builder | Best For | Starting Price | Learning Curve | App Type | Custom Domain |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bubble | Full web apps | Free / $29/mo | Steep | Web apps | Free tier |
| Webflow | Marketing sites | Free / $18/mo | Medium | Marketing sites | Basic plan |
| Framer | Landing pages | Free / $5/mo | Low | Marketing sites | Mini plan |
| Softr | Portals | Free / $29/mo | Low | Portal apps | Starter plan |

| FlutterFlow | Native mobile apps | Free / $30/mo | Medium | Mobile apps | Standard plan |
| Glide | Simple mobile apps | Free / $25/mo | Very Low | Mobile apps | Starter plan |

## Gartner Data: 75% of Apps Use Low-Code by 2026

Gartner's 2026 forecast has proven accurate. The explosion of low-code adoption is driven by three factors:

1. **Labor shortage:** There are 40 million unfilled developer positions globally
2. **AI integration:** All major no-code platforms now integrate with LLM APIs for AI-powered features
3. **Cost reduction:** No-code app development costs 60-80% less than traditional development

## FAQ

### Which no-code builder is best for a SaaS MVP?
Bubble is the clear winner for SaaS MVPs. Its database, workflow engine, and API integrations let you build production-ready web applications. Many successful SaaS companies (including AirDev and Zeroqode) started on Bubble.

### Can I build a mobile app with these tools?
For native mobile apps, FlutterFlow is the best choice. For simple mobile apps, Glide is easier. Bubble and Softr can build mobile-responsive web apps but not true native apps.

### What is the cheapest no-code website builder?
Framer at $5/month (Mini plan) is the cheapest for a professional website with a custom domain. For free options, Wix Studio offers the most features on its free tier.

### Which platform has the best SEO?
Webflow leads for SEO with full control over meta tags, structured data, sitemaps, and automatic clean HTML output. Framer is close behind.

### Can I migrate my site from one no-code builder to another?
Migration is difficult in most cases. Bubble and Webflow sites are particularly hard to migrate due to their proprietary systems. Plan carefully before committing to a platform.

## Summary

The "best" no-code builder depends entirely on what you are building:

**SaaS or marketplace?** → Bubble
**Marketing site or portfolio?** → Webflow or Framer
**Landing page with animations?** → Framer
**Client portal or membership site?** → Softr
**Small business site?** → Wix Studio
**Native mobile app?** → FlutterFlow
**Quick internal dashboard?** → Glide

With 75% of new applications using low-code in 2026, there has never been a better time to build without code. Start with a free trial of your top two choices and see which workflow clicks for you.
